changelog.en: If Power PDF is licensed with a serial number, setup now explains that the Add-on Store needs Power PDF Business SaaS and offers a button to request a quote from Tungsten Automation.
changelog.de: Ist Power PDF mit einer Seriennummer lizenziert, erklärt das Setup jetzt, dass der Add-on Store Power PDF Business SaaS benötigt, und bietet eine Schaltfläche, um ein Angebot bei Tungsten Automation anzufordern.

changelog.it: Se Power PDF è concesso in licenza con un numero di serie, il programma di installazione ora spiega che l'Add-on Store richiede Power PDF Business SaaS e offre un pulsante per richiedere un preventivo a Tungsten Automation.
changelog.es: Si Power PDF tiene licencia con un número de serie, el programa de instalación ahora explica que Add-on Store necesita Power PDF Business SaaS y ofrece un botón para solicitar un presupuesto a Tungsten Automation.
changelog.nl: Als Power PDF met een serienummer is gelicentieerd, legt de installatie nu uit dat de Add-on Store Power PDF Business SaaS nodig heeft en biedt een knop om een offerte bij Tungsten Automation aan te vragen.
changelog.pt: Se o Power PDF estiver licenciado com um número de série, a instalação agora explica que a Add-on Store precisa do Power PDF Business SaaS e oferece um botão para solicitar uma cotação à Tungsten Automation.

changelog.sv: Om Power PDF är licensierad med ett serienummer förklarar installationen nu att Add-on Store kräver Power PDF Business SaaS och erbjuder en knapp för att begära en offert från Tungsten Automation.
changelog.pl: Jeśli Power PDF jest licencjonowany numerem seryjnym, instalator wyjaśnia teraz, że Add-on Store wymaga Power PDF Business SaaS, i oferuje przycisk, aby poprosić Tungsten Automation o ofertę.

changelog.hu: Ha a Power PDF sorozatszámmal van licencelve, a telepítő most elmagyarázza, hogy az Add-on Store-hoz Power PDF Business SaaS szükséges, és gombot kínál árajánlat kéréséhez a Tungsten Automationtől.

changelog.tr: Power PDF bir seri numarasıyla lisanslanmışsa kurulum artık Add-on Store'un Power PDF Business SaaS gerektirdiğini açıklıyor ve Tungsten Automation'dan teklif istemek için bir düğme sunuyor.

changelog.ar: إذا كان Power PDF مرخّصًا برقم تسلسلي، يوضح برنامج الإعداد الآن أن Add-on Store يتطلب Power PDF Business SaaS، ويعرض زرًا لطلب عرض سعر من Tungsten Automation.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). Since 1.9.8 the setup shows, on a Power PDF licensed with a serial number, a dialog whose button "Request a quote" opens Tungsten Automation's public quote page in the default browser (only on that click, never in silent installs); the setup itself sends nothing. The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

externalServices.name: Tungsten Automation quote page (setup only, serial-number Power PDF)
externalServices.data: None from the setup: the button opens the public page in the default browser (tungstenautomation.de for German, .fr for French, .com otherwise); the browser then talks to that website as with any link.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
